title: Risk-Triggered Search: Behavior-Preserving Safe Control
abstract: arXiv:2611.24409v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Pre-trained visual world models generate multi-step action plans from current and goal observations, yet terminal-proximity objectives fail to prevent forbidden-zone traversal or rigid-body collision sliding. Purely visual interfaces may lack analytical dynamics, structured states, or explicit collision geometry, requiring internal prediction of action-conditioned process risk. We propose Risk-Triggered Search (RTS) for frozen Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA) world models. Rather than relying on static state features that cannot distinguish candidate plans sharing an observation, RTS unrolls action-conditioned future latent prefixes in the frozen world model and trains a lightweight risk head with process-violation supervision. translated_title: 风险触发搜索：行为保持的安全控制
translated_abstract: 预训练的视觉世界模型能够根据当前观测和目标观测生成多步动作计划，然而仅以接近终点为目标的函数无法防止穿越禁区或刚体碰撞滑移。纯视觉接口可能缺乏解析动力学、结构化状态或显式碰撞几何信息，因此需要对动作条件下的过程风险进行内部预测。我们提出了一种面向冻结的联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）世界模型的风险触发搜索方法。RTS不再依赖无法区分共享同一观测的候选计划的静态状态特征，而是在冻结的世界模型中展开动作条件下的未来潜在前缀，并通过过程违规监督训练一个轻量级风险预测头。为了在保持安全标称行为的同时实现选择性干预，RTS将相同的预测前缀风险准则同时用作搜索触发门控和硬可行性门控：安全标称计划得以执行……
tldr: 提出风险触发搜索（RTS），通过在冻结的JEPA世界模型中预测动作条件下的潜在前缀风险，并将同一风险准则同时用作搜索触发门控与硬可行性门控，在不破坏安全标称行为的前提下实现安全控制。
en_tdlr: Proposes Risk-Triggered Search (RTS), which predicts action-conditioned latent prefix risk within a frozen JEPA world model and uses the same risk criterion as both a search trigger gate and a hard feasibility gate, achieving safe control while preserving safe nominal behavior.
